title: Michael half-recognizes Doty from a photo

tellings.quote: I see a I I can't picture him, but I see I see a guy like him.

plain: Michael Johnson, a former US Air Force guard at Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, says he had an unexplained encounter while on duty in 1977. On the podcast of host Jesse Michels, he was shown a photo of Richard Doty, a former Air Force investigator, and says he half recognizes him: he cannot picture the face clearly, but he remembers seeing a man like him. If true, it would hint that Air Force investigators dealt with him after the event.
